name: Tempered Gaff
description: Thrust along a straight line that ends with the tines spread to bracket the opponent's arm.

name: Silt Fork
description: Pivot a half turn so that the fork lies between the opponent's weapon and the body.

name: Murktrio
description: Cross the outer tines over an incoming blade and press it down toward the ground.

name: Aegis Triplehead
description: Brace the haft against the hip so that a hard shove stops against the whole body.

name: Gyvepinch
description: Trap a blade between two tines and twist the haft hard to lock it with qi.

name: Staggering Pinch
description: Drive the tines into the ground across a fleeing opponent's trailing cloak to pin it fast.

name: Thorntrident
description: Lay a ring of qi along the ground at the tines' reach so that the next foot to cross it is caught.

name: Tridentcuirass
description: Spread the tines around a weapon arm and press with held qi so that the arm cannot lift or draw back.

name: Scalding Hookbarb
description: Gather qi in the center prong ahead of a jab so that the point lands as a hard narrow stab.

name: Gusttrident
description: Roll the haft over the forearms in front of the chest to turn aside a thrown knife.

name: Bounding Socketbase
description: Step toward the opponent with the tines probing ahead of the foot to test the guard.

name: Blazetriple
description: Lift an outer tine upward through the opponent's wrist and carry the cut on to the elbow.

name: Forkassault
description: Release stored qi down the center prong in a burst that punches through a shield facing.

name: Thorn Forktine
description: Wrap the haft in a close field of qi that turns aside cuts for as long as the breath holds.

name: Gust Barbtine
description: Spread qi equally down all three prongs and strike so that three small wounds open together.

name: Prongroot Thrash
description: Extend a lance of qi from the center prong along the thrust to strike beyond the physical tines.

name: Waning Sidetine
description: Draw qi into the haft and release it as a pulse that sends the force of a blow back into the attacker.

name: Blaze Seize
description: Grip the haft behind the balance point and heave the trident overhand at a close target.

name: Silt Midtine
description: Plant the rear foot and step through to carry the body's weight into a cast.

name: Rumblegig
description: Cast the trident sideways from the hip at a low target such as an advancing shin.

name: Thorn Gig
description: Haul in a trident tied to a cord after a cast by pulling hand over hand.

name: Hoarfrost Prongdrive
description: Shift the grip rearward and cast with a qi-sped whip of the arm to carry the trident far.

name: Torrent Prongdrive
description: Drop a hand to the ground at the end of a cast and roll out to a second weapon.

name: Dominating Barbtine
description: Bind the thrown trident to the hand with a thread of qi and pull it back through the target.

name: Furrowing Fork
description: Cast at one opponent and let the qi tether snap the trident back through a second in its path.

name: Facet Triprong
description: Set all three tines against an opponent's chest and lean in to keep the distance.

name: Seizespurt
description: Advance with the tines pressed against a shield so that the pressure never slackens.

name: Ponderous Pinch
description: Press the fork on the heel line of a stepping foot and hold it down.

name: Prongroot Assault
description: Release the lean in a sudden jab at the moment the opponent presses back.

name: Equipoise Tridentshaft
description: Cross the tines over a shield rim and press the rim down to open the face.

name: Shadetrio
description: Press the tines one by one against ribs and sternum and throat and let qi weight build at each.

name: Gust Sidetine
description: Lean into the haft with qi added to the body's weight to push a guarded opponent back.

name: Toxin Forktine
description: Pin a shield with the tines and lift it in a burst of qi to expose the arm behind.

name: Dominating Seize
description: Concentrate qi at the three tines until their combined pressure collapses an opponent's guard.

name: Tearing Triplehead
description: Release all the held pressure through the center prong at once to shatter a braced guard.

name: Enduring Triprong
description: Hold the haft with both hands moving as a pair so that the guard flows like a river current.

name: Hastening Gaff
description: Step in curving pairs that follow the bend of a river around the opponent.

name: Splintering Gig
description: Jab with the left outer tine and then the right in a matched pair at the guard.

name: Torrent Midtine
description: Lower the tines to a basin curve and draw a high cut down into the guard.

name: Glintpinch
description: Drive both outer tines in at a matched angle and sharpen them with qi to catch armor gaps.

name: Iron Hookbarb
description: Spin the haft in a smooth current-like circle that carries qi from one hand to the other.

name: Fastening Midtine
description: Catch an attacking haft where the tines open like a river mouth and drag it aside.

name: Rumble Prongdrive
description: Send two currents of qi down the paired outer tines so that they strike one after the other.

name: Deed Socketbase
description: Lay a shallow pool of qi at the foot of the stance to snare whoever steps into it.

name: Triplecuirass
description: Hold the haft across the body with qi running in two currents toward each hand.

name: Seizetorment
description: Dive the tines from above at a falling angle like a hawk's stoop onto the shoulder.

name: Gust Tridentshaft
description: Glide along an imagined bank with each step matched by the opposite hand's movement.

name: Barbtine Fastness
description: Catch a thrust in the notch between center and outer tine and shed it down one current.

name: Sanguine Tridentshaft
description: Flow the tines low along the ground and prick the ankle of an advancing foot.

name: Dominating Prongroot
description: Pin the shoulder with two tines at once and hold it still while the third prong threatens.

name: Compressing Forktine
description: Cross the two currents of qi in the fork so that an incoming blade is pushed two ways at once.

name: Triplethrash
description: Sweep the haft wide like a hawk's wing to strike the guard on one side and then the other.

name: Rumble Fork
description: Draw qi up from the legs like basin water rising and send it out through a rising thrust.

name: Splintering Iron Sidetine
description: Drive a thrust in which two streams of qi down the haft meet at the tip of the center prong.

name: Gighauberk
description: Hold both currents steady through the fork to seal an opponent's weapon arm against any motion for a few breaths.

name: Tempered Seize
description: Stab with the outer tines curved inward like talons to seize flesh and cloth.

name: Silt Triplehead
description: Settle onto the balls of the feet like a perched hawk and step off in any direction.

name: Chime Socketbase
description: Fold the haft close along the forearm and catch a cut on the wood before the talons strike.

name: Gyvetrio
description: Close the outer tines on a wrist and pull as a hawk pulls its prey.

name: Severing Pinch
description: Drop from a leap with the tines first so that all three points land together and grasp.

name: Torrent Gig
description: Plant the butt and let qi lift the body in a short vault over a low guard.

name: Chime Forktine
description: Clamp a weapon's guard in the outer tines and rip it away with a hawk's twist.

name: Triprong Cloak
description: Circle the tines overhead and lay a hovering trap of qi that drops on the next movement made within it.

name: Facettrident
description: Take a bearing on the opponent and hold the tines fixed on it as if sworn to the line.

name: Might Tridentshaft
description: Walk the edge of a plateau step by step with the tines pointed along the open side.

name: Might Seize
description: Time a thrust with a gust of wind so that the trident rides it forward.

name: Murk Hookbarb
description: Hold the guard fast like an oath and turn each cut aside along the same bearing.

name: Torrent Pinch
description: Pivot on open ground so that the wind stays at the back and the tines face the foe.

name: Might Midtine
description: Sweep the tines across the line of the wind and let qi carry the cut in a long flat arc.

name: Driving Gaff
description: Hold a bearing and jab through it with qi that follows the line straight to the target.

name: Facet Hookbarb
description: Plant the haft against a charge like a windbreak that the rushing force must flow around.

name: Deed Triplehead
description: Stake a line of qi in the wind's path so that anyone who crosses it is jerked sideways.

name: Cleaving Gaff
description: Loose a thrust along a sworn bearing with qi so steady that the point arrives exactly where the tines were aimed.

name: Raging Triprong
description: Jab the center prong at the first opening as a promise kept to the line.

name: Iron Prongroot
description: Rake an outer prong across the arm that answered the first jab.

name: Gust Prongdrive
description: Step back a pace into the wind and hold the tines steady against its push.

name: Sidetine Fastness
description: Cover the line of the third point with the haft to catch the counterblow.

name: Gust Gig
description: Land three jabs along a single line one after another each backed by a surge of qi.

name: Thorntrio
description: Hold the haft along the edge of the opponent's reach and let qi bend blows past.

name: Torrent Barbtine
description: Plant each foot as if on plateau rock with qi holding the stance against pushes.

name: Pinchhauberk
description: Hold a caught weapon in the fork and let sustained qi keep it bound until the user lets go.

name: Lot Socketbase
description: Set the three tines against three points on a guard and seal its motion with qi.

name: Aegistriple
description: Stand with the fork forward and the body low so the wind passes over without unsettling the guard.

name: Rumbletrident
description: Drive the tines into a headwind with the shoulder lowered so the thrust stays true.

name: Gustgaff
description: Let a tailwind push each stride longer while the tines stay aimed ahead.

name: Equipoise Sidetine
description: Turn the haft across the wind so that a cut is carried off to the side.

name: Vaulting Triprong
description: Slip sideways on the lull between gusts to leave a charging opponent striking air.

name: Iron Gig
description: Rake the barbed tine across the opponent's arm in the still breath after a gust.

name: Glint Fork
description: Feed a gust of wind into the thrust with qi so that the fork drives deeper than the arm alone.

name: Equipoise Triplehead
description: Flick the haft in a fast whistling arc so that qi throws aside any weapon it meets.

name: Gyveseize
description: Cast the barbed tine out on a gust and hook a distant arm or weapon to pull it in.

name: Siltpinch
description: Chain quick steps along the shoulder of the wind so that the tines are always at the opponent's side.

name: Tempered Forktine
description: Hold qi in the fork for a long breath then release it in a thrust that pierces a guarded body.

name: Hoarfrost Socketbase
description: Hold the haft out in front and let a broad field of qi stand where no wall could be raised.
